description: Modern keyboard shortcuts manager for Herdr: press-to-record key capture, same-section and cross-section conflict detection, custom command/send/mod bindings, Quick Actions shortcuts, search by key, and session undo.

settings.label: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.hint: View, search, record and resolve conflicts across all sections of keys.json.

settings.label: Shortcut of Keybinds
settings.hint: Saved in keys.json. Replaces Herdr's default Ctrl+Shift+? / Ctrl+Shift+/ help dialog.

settings.label: Show macOS bindings
settings.hint: Show cmd-* shortcuts on Windows and Linux. Hidden macOS bindings are never deleted when editing other keys.
